finding: V6251 can call the historical global v095DecorateXp several times while the startup quiet/loading gate is still active.
v095DecorateXp performs a presentation-only DOM TreeWalker scan over the visible game UI, so repeated startup calls add avoidable work before first-playable.
The event reward logic and EXP event state are separate from this decorator.
changes: During the canonical startup-quiet window, repeated v095DecorateXp calls are deferred and coalesced into one trailing pass.
Outside startup quiet, v095DecorateXp behaves unchanged.
No EXP values, event activation, rewards or gameplay state are changed.
Diagnostics report xpDecoratorGuardInstalls, xpStartupScansDeferred and xpDeferredRuns.
